title: Hearing on Juneteenth and enslaved African burial sites
summary: The Council Committee on Cultural Affairs, Libraries and International Relations held an oversight hearing on Juneteenth commemorations and burial sites of formerly enslaved African Americans in New York City. The committee also heard Int. 220-2026, which would require the Department of Cultural Affairs to identify, mark, map and educate the public about such burial sites citywide, along with several unrelated commemorative resolutions including ones honoring the Feast of San Gennaro, Kappa Alpha Psi, Willie Colón and Maria Antonia Cay.
